parsed.post: Experiment with DEPTH=6 significantly improved val_bpb from 1.087277 to 1.061423. Scaling capacity seems effective. Next, I will try increasing the DEPTH even further to 8 and adjusting the MATRIX_LR to 0.15 to see if a higher learning rate can sustain the increased parameter count.
parsed.description: Increasing model depth to 8 and increasing learning rate to 0.15 to support higher capacity.
